puzzles.title: The unlit glass roof
puzzles.subtitle: Night Gardens
puzzles.story: The night gardener has left a lamp plan on the bench. Light every open square, meet the numbered wall counts and keep lamps out of one another's sight.
puzzles.difficultyEvidence: Only 7 numbered walls constrain 40 open squares; coverage and no-glare exclusions interact across long rows and columns. Provisional editorial tier.

puzzles.title: The staggered cisterns
puzzles.subtitle: Night Gardens
puzzles.story: The nursery cisterns share a survey sheet, not a water level. Choose a level for each tank, filling every lower layer, so all row and column totals agree.
puzzles.difficultyEvidence: Nine tanks include 5 spanning three or more heights; waterline bounds interact across both sets of totals rather than independent wet cells. Provisional editorial tier.
